messages:
Priya S: FYI saw a persistent tiny stream of fncall validation rejects that end up on the degen route in sa-east. Not huge but noisy for the partner.
Omar T: Can you paste a sanitized sample? helps to know if it's input vs tool_output.
Priya S: Sample (sanitized):
```json
{"session":"s_900","tool_output":[{"text":"ok"}],"meta":{}}
```
Priya S: Our schema expects {\"tool_output\": {\"items\": [...], \"meta\":{}}} so the bare-array form trips the strict union.
Lin W: This is the same array-vs-object union but reoccurring. We debated auto-coerce before. Two options: 1) add gateway adapter that normalizes incoming shapes (adapter-normalizer); 2) allow validator auto-coerce for small diffs.
Omar T: Adapter-normalizer is cleaner long-term (single place to normalize across SDKs), but takes several sprints. Auto-coerce is faster.
ops-bot: Alert: fncall_validation_reject_rate (sa-east) > 1% for 15m. https://console/redwood/alerts/5566
Priya S: Ops ask: before we auto-coerce, can we 1) increase deterministic sampling for failing orgs so we capture the same subset of fails consistently, 2) emit validation_decision tag (auto_coerce|reject) and a tiny coercion_delta blob (redacted) for auditing.
Finance-bot: Finance note: when requests route to degen but no backend tool executed, we need a clear chargeback label. Suggest "fallback_discount" tag and a provisional billing rate (25%).
Lin W: Implementation plan (short-term): flip per-org flag validator.coerce.enable=true for affected org for 48h, emit trace tags validation_decision & validation_confidence, bump failing-sample to 10% with deterministic hashing by org_id.
Omar T: Also add route_tag=fallback_origin so downstream billing can filter. We'll emit executed_tool=null when tool wasn't called.
Priya S: Console UX ask: add "Schema Diagnostics" mini-panel under fncall that shows top-3 mismatched fields, one scrubbed example per mismatch, and a button to flip per-org coerce flag. Include a small diff viewer (expected vs observed).
UX-Liz: I can mock the panel. It should surface confidence and the coercion_delta length. Also expose the audit trail for toggles.
Lin W: Long-term plan: build adapter-normalizer service in front of fncall router that runs light-weight normalizers (array->items, string->int coercer, date formats). This reduces per-org hacks.
Omar T: Agreed. Action items now: A) implement per-org coercion flag + trace tags (PR 4821); B) enable deterministic sampling 10% for failing orgs (ops change); C) Console widget RFC (UX-Liz).
Priya S: Quick test: flipped coerce flag for org_kk for 30m, rejects dropped from 14 -> 1 in 12m and we captured 8 deterministic samples.
Finance-bot: Finance accepts provisional rule: fallback_discount tag => 25% billing for non-executed fallbacks until policy final. We'll reconcile after postmortem.
Omar T: We'll keep the flag on for up to 48h while we push SDK normalization guidance and the adapter RFC.
Priya S: Postmortem notes: 1) ship SDK serializer examples for tool_output unions; 2) implement validation_decision metric and validation_confidence histogram; 3) Console widget and per-org toggle; 4) RFC for adapter-normalizer.
Lin W: I'll start the RFC; Omar will open the runtime PR.
Priya S: Thanks all  monitoring for 2h then reverting if stable. :white_check_mark:
